nba.shooting_stars_two_point_spot_skill.assessment: Fills the gap that the 3-point-only spot profile leaves: four of the seven Shooting Stars locations are 2-point locations (official 2026 rules PDF). Definition is computable for active players from shot-level zone and action-type data, but the legend component, the attempts per spot and the point values are placeholders or UNVERIFIED, so it stays NOT_COMPUTED and must not drive a win probability.
raw_data: player shot-level rows with zone, action type (dunk, layup, jump shot) and result for the last 3 seasons
career FT% and mid-range FG% by season for legends
pass-to-release timing from past Shooting Stars video (hand-coded)
announced team spot order (UNVERIFIED rules fields)

sources.name: Hand-coded Shooting Stars video

nba.asg_selectee_nonparticipation_hazard.assessment: The right population for the MVP clause (All-Star selectees, not contest entrants). Computable from past rosters, replacement announcements and injury-report vintages, but the sample is a few hundred player-events, the vintage archive for 2010-2026 injury reports is incomplete from public sources, and the meaning of 'participate' is unverified, so it stays NOT_COMPUTED.
raw_data: All-Star selectees by year with starter or reserve flag
injury status vintages for selectees in the week before the game
minutes played by selectee per event game

sources.name: NBA official injury report archive
sources.note: must be archived live; older vintages incomplete

nba.team_bench_points_model.assessment: Computable from box scores with starter flags and confirmed lineups for the team-total reading, but the entity of KXNBABENCHPTS (team total or a player as a bench player) is unresolved and no market is listed, so the input's applicability to that series is unverified; it composes nba.bench_minutes_distribution and nba.bench_scoring and is not a duplicate of them. Data-source provenance is not marked verified because it was never checked against the contract.
raw_data: player-game box score with starter flag, minutes and points
